We have trained model and cross-validation. Need to create JSON file with keys test_set_evaluation (mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance) and cross_validation_results (r2_mean, r2_std). We have test metrics from training result: mae 0.3910957510202049, rmse 0.4955406989624358, r2 0.4773045931964437, feature_importance dict. Cross-validation results: r2_mean 0.7614530258672764, r2_std 0.10349565069591328.

We need to write JSON file to some path, maybe results.json in workdir. Use write_file tool.
